b: I'm currently reading P.J. O'Rourke's Holidays in Hell and decided to look up the author to see more about him. I didn't know anything about him, save for this book, and I found a reddit post about his death. Plenty of people were mourning him and saying how funny his work was, but then a few people were saying how unpleasant he was in real life.
It got me thinking, would I even WANT to meet an author I especially enjoy or look up to. They say you should never meet your heroes...
Like, at a book signing, for example. Has anyone ever been to one of these and walked out feeling unfulfilled? Or regretful?
Conversely, I'd love to hear about times where the opposite has happened and the interaction was everything you could want and more.
